name: Tomato

basicInfo.description: Classic tomatoes are the king of the home garden. These full-sized tomatoes are perfect for slicing, cooking, and making sauces. More challenging than cherry tomatoes but incredibly rewarding.
whyGrow: Versatile for salads, sauces, and cooking
One plant can yield 4–6 kg of fruit
basicInfo.water: Deep watering 2-3 times per week, keep soil evenly moist

growingSteps: Plant seeds 0.5 cm deep indoors 6-8 weeks before last frost
Transplant seedlings outdoors after frost risk passes
Stake or cage plants to support growth
Water deeply and mulch to retain moisture
Harvest ripe tomatoes when fully colored

careCalendar.description: Start seeds in trays with moist potting mix.
Move seedlings to garden after frost danger is gone.
Support plants with stakes or cages as they grow taller.
Apply balanced fertilizer to encourage fruiting.
Pick first ripe tomatoes and continue harvesting regularly.

symptoms: Dark sunken spots on fruit bottoms
Splits or cracks in ripe tomatoes

harvestingGuide: Harvest tomatoes when fully colored and slightly soft to the touch. Twist gently or cut with scissors to avoid damaging the vine. Regular harvesting encourages more fruit production.
estimatedSavings: Growing tomatoes at home can save $100–150 per season, especially if you cook often with sauces or salads.
